description: Verify of the §4.2 detached compact JWS with "crit" removed from the protected header, {"alg":"HS256","b64":false}, and a signature that is otherwise valid (HMAC-SHA256 over the unencoded signing input with the RFC 7515 A.1 key, derived with Python hmac and node:crypto since the RFC prints none): "b64" without "crit" is rejected with InvalidHeader (ADR 0026 §4; RFC 7797 §6, §8)
